game.name: Roblox: DOORS
game.rules:
# **Main Rules**

- No use of third-party applications to give an advantage (macros, shaders, exploits, etc.) with the exception of gamma.
- All runs need to be performed on the **official version** of the game [(linked here)](https://www.roblox.com/games/6516141723/FLOOR-2-DOORS).
- Revives are not allowed.
- Taking items from the rift is not allowed.
- Glitches that may be **game-breaking** (e.g. skipping a consecutive amount of rooms with little to no movement/ skipping whole boss fights in seconds) are **not** allowed.
- The use of Alt + 1, or the Roblox screenshot capture system, as an advantage to see past certain UI on screen (such as seeing past the beginning text on the mines) is not allowed in runs

- Performance Stats are allowed except for Shift + F2 (in-game) since it allows you to see the correct door through walls.
- You **may** increase your maximum FPS in settings as there are no noticeable advantages.
- You are allowed to rebind a key to a different bind, however you are not allowed to rebind any key to the scroll wheel.
- Absolutely no **modifiers** are allowed, with the single exception being the Hotel- modifier to play the Legacy (Hotel-) version. The admin panel is not allowed.
- **Timer is optional and is not required.**
- If you happen to disconnect/leave **in a co-op with the Current version**, you must include that in the recording otherwise it will invalidate the run (this does **not** include Solos).
- In **co-op runs**, any players **disconnecting or leaving** in the Legacy (Hotel-) version is **not** allowed.
- **All co-op runs** must have POVs included in the speedrun description, or the video link area. 

# **Recording Rules**

- Video must be raw/unedited (unless editing a timer/subtitles in).
- **Audio is required to be audible across every run, as well as having some sort of viewable quality (preferably above 25fps)**
- For solo runs, doorknobs and revives must be visible in the top right corner with nothing blocking it. **Top 5 co-op runs require doorknobs to be visible across all povs**.
- **XBOX players** are allowed to stop and then start recording immediately after since they can only record to 10 minutes.

## Gameplay Rules:

- All runs need to be performed on the **official version** of the game [(linked here)](https://www.roblox.com/games/6516141723/FLOOR-2-DOORS).
- Revives are **not** allowed.
- You **may** increase your maximum FPS in settings as there are no noticeable advantages.
- SUPER HARD MODE!!! and RETRO MODE are not allowed. Legacy (Hotel-) runs can be submitted.
- Glitches that may be **game-breaking** (e.g. skipping a consecutive amount of rooms with little to no movement/ skipping whole boss fights in seconds) are **not** allowed.
- No use of third-party applications to give an advantage (macros, shaders, exploits, etc.) with the exception of gamma.
- You are allowed to rebind a key to a different bind, however you are not allowed to rebind any key to the scroll wheel.
- Performance Stats are allowed except for Shift + F2 (in-game) since it allows you to see the correct door through walls.
- The use of Alt + 1, or the Roblox Screenshot Capture System as an advantage to see past certain UI on screen (such as "The Mines" text/logo) is not allowed in runs.

## Recording Rules:

- **All co-op runs** must have all POVs of players included in the speedrun description, or the video link area. 
- Video must be raw/unedited (unless editing a timer/subtitles in).
- Timers are optional and not required.
- Knob counter/revives must be visible in the top right corner for the **entire** duration of gameplay (load-times excluded)
- For solo runs, doorknobs and revives must be visible in the top right corner with nothing blocking it. **Top 5 co-op runs require doorknobs to be visible across all POVs**.
- **Audio is required to be audible across every run, as well as having some sort of viewable quality (preferably above 25fps)**.
- **(XBOX Players only)** For longer runs, you are allowed to break up the recording into 2 or more videos due to only being able to record up to 10 minutes at a time. For these cases, you must restart the recording as soon as possible, and you may ***not*** cut out major parts of the run.

categories.name: The Mines
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- The pre-run shop is not allowed for world record runs.
- You are **NOT** allowed to carry over items from previous floors.
- Max time limit for runs is 1 hour.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is not allowed.

# Timing Rules

- Time starts as soon as **"The Mines"** text appears.
- Time ends the frame the interaction bar on the castle door resets after being fully filled up (no more game inputs are required at this point).

categories.name: All Main Floors
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- Complete **The Hotel** and **The Mines** in one go.
- Splicing together separate runs is not allowed, the runs must be done in one recording session.
- You must start the run from The Hotel.
- The run will only be considered as **part of the shop category** if you buy an item from **the Pre-Run Shop**.
- You are not allowed to use rifted or backdoor items.
- Max time limit for runs is 1 hour and 30 minutes.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is not allowed.

# Timing Rules

- Runs will be retimed removing loads and following retiming rules from both floors.
- Runs will **not count** if one or multiple players enter the Hotel **by exiting The rooms**.
- Run starts when the avatars disappear on the elevator door in **The Hotel**, and ends with the screen turning black whilst seeing the interactive buttons in **The Mines**

categories.name: The Rooms
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- You are allowed to submit a run(s) that fits multiple room categories (ex: submitting a 1-1000 run to 1-250).
- You are not allowed to use items from the backdoor such as the vial/bottle of starlight.
- You are not allowed to use the Barrel of Starlight.
- You **are** allowed to bring other items from the Hotel, the Mines, and the Rooms.
- The ending frame of the door opening, for any room category, must be fully visible, and should not have entities such as A-60 open the final door to x room category you are running.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is only allowed in co-op runs.

# Recording Rules

- You must start your recording before or while you are loading into The Rooms (generally start your recording before the starting cutscene).
- **It is preferred that you aim a flashlight at the final room door that you are opening, as it'll help us tell when the frame the door opens.**

#

categories.name: The Backdoor
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- You must start your recording before or while you are loading into The Backdoor (generally start your recording before "Loading..." appears).
- Max time limit for runs is 10 minutes.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is only allowed in co-op runs.

# Timing Rules

- Time starts as soon as the interior behind the entrance door is visible (and where the door is clearly opening and passable)
- Older runs before The Mines released start as soon as "The Backdoor" text appears.
- Time ends the frame the interaction bar on the exit door resets after being fully filled up (no more game inputs are required at this point).

categories.name: RETRO MODE
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- You must start your recording before opening the first door.
- Video must be raw/unedited (unless editing a timer in).
- Max time limit for runs is 15 minutes.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is only allowed in co-op runs.

# Timing

- Time starts the frame the screen turns gray after opening the first door.
- Time ends the frame the screen turns gray after interacting with the ending portal.

categories.name: SUPER HARD MODE!!!
categories.rules:
# **General Rules**

- In **No Shop** runs, you are **not** allowed to buy from the pre-run shop, you are however allowed to buy from Jeff's Shop.
- The run will only be considered as **part of the shop category** if you buy an item from **the Pre-Run Shop**.

- You are not allowed to use rifted items
- Max time limit for runs is 40 minutes

# **Timing Rules**

- Time starts as soon as the avatar icon(s) on the elevator door at the start disappears. 
**The recording must start and show that the elevator is closed with the avatar icon(s) shown the entire time (until it disappears) on the elevator**
- Time ends the frame the camera starts to pan out or when your character teleports when entering the elevator. If doing co-op and you still have people alive, the time ends the frame the last person enters the elevator.

values.rules:
*(These are the rules for the Legacy (Hotel-) version; select the appropriate version before reading.)*

# General Rules

- In no shop runs, you are not allowed to buy from the ***pre-run shop***, you are however allowed to buy from the mid-run shop.
- In shop runs, buying an item from the pre-run shop will be considered as a shop run.
- Max time limit for runs is 30 minutes.
- In **co-op runs**, any players **disconnecting or leaving** in the Legacy (Hotel-) version is **not** allowed.

# Timing Rules

- Time starts as soon as the **avatar icon(s)** on the **elevator door** disappears (just look at the elevator door at all times).
- Time ends the frame the ending cutscene begins (when one of the the following things happen):

1. Lighting Change (noticeable on high graphics, the boxes change color and the gate has a shadow), usually happens first
2. Elevator Gate appearing - **Noticeable on the ground of the elevator as well** (when the shadows of the gate are visible)
3. Character Teleporting
4. Items/Healthbar disappearing
5. Camera Panning

### Collect 1,000 points in RANKED mode.

# Gameplay Rules

- In co-op, collusion is fair play; you are allowed to team with your friends to collect 1,000 points as fast as possible.

# Timing

- In co-op, the POV that collects 1,000 points the fastest will be the timed POV.
- Time starts the frame that the *GO* text is visible after *3, 2, 1*.
- Time ends the first frame that you have 1,000+ points.

### Collect the most points you can before sudden death in RANKED mode.

# Gameplay Rules

- In co-op, collusion is fair play; you are allowed to team with your friends to collect as many points as possible.
- Minimum score is 1,000.

# Scoring

- The POV that has the most points at the end is the score of the run.
- In this category, **longer times are better** and ranked higher in the leaderboard.
- Put the **thousandths** place in the *seconds* of the run, and the **hundreds/tens/ones** places in the *milliseconds* of the submission.
  - Ex. 1,234 would be 1s 234ms.

- Put the highest door number you entered in the *milliseconds* of the submission.

categories.name: The Rooms
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- You are allowed to submit a run(s) that fits multiple room categories (ex: submitting a 1-1000 run to 1-250).
- You are not allowed to use items from the backdoor such as the vial/bottle of starlight.
- You are not allowed to use the Barrel of Starlight.
- You **are** allowed to bring other items from the Hotel, the Mines, and the Rooms.
- The ending frame of the door opening, for any room category, must be fully visible, and should not have entities such as A-60 open the final door to x room category you are running.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is only allowed in co-op runs.

# Recording Rules

- You must start your recording before or while you are loading into The Rooms (generally start your recording before the starting cutscene).
- **It is preferred that you aim a flashlight at the final room door that you are opening, as it'll help us tell when the frame the door opens.**

#

categories.name: All Main Floors
categories.rules:
# General Rules

- Complete **The Hotel** and **The Mines** in one go.
- Splicing together separate runs is not allowed, the runs must be done in one recording session.
- You must start the run from The Hotel.
- The run will only be considered as **part of the shop category** if you buy an item from **the Pre-Run Shop**.
- You are not allowed to use rifted or backdoor items.
- Max time limit for runs is 1 hour and 30 minutes.
- Using **Glitch Fragments** is not allowed.

# Timing Rules

- Runs will be retimed removing loads and following retiming rules from both floors.
- Runs will **not count** if one or multiple players enter the Hotel **by exiting The rooms**.
- Run starts when the avatars disappear on the elevator door in **The Hotel**, and ends with the screen turning black whilst seeing the interactive buttons in **The Mines**

games.name: Roblox: DOORS
games.rules:
# **Main Rules**

- No use of third-party applications to give an advantage (macros, shaders, exploits, etc.) with the exception of gamma.
- All runs need to be performed on the **official version** of the game [(linked here)](https://www.roblox.com/games/6516141723/FLOOR-2-DOORS).
- Revives are not allowed.
- Taking items from the rift is not allowed.
- Glitches that may be **game-breaking** (e.g. skipping a consecutive amount of rooms with little to no movement/ skipping whole boss fights in seconds) are **not** allowed.
- The use of Alt + 1, or the Roblox screenshot capture system, as an advantage to see past certain UI on screen (such as seeing past the beginning text on the mines) is not allowed in runs

- Performance Stats are allowed except for Shift + F2 (in-game) since it allows you to see the correct door through walls.
- You **may** increase your maximum FPS in settings as there are no noticeable advantages.
- You are allowed to rebind a key to a different bind, however you are not allowed to rebind any key to the scroll wheel.
- Absolutely no **modifiers** are allowed, with the single exception being the Hotel- modifier to play the Legacy (Hotel-) version. The admin panel is not allowed.
- **Timer is optional and is not required.**
- If you happen to disconnect/leave **in a co-op with the Current version**, you must include that in the recording otherwise it will invalidate the run (this does **not** include Solos).
- In **co-op runs**, any players **disconnecting or leaving** in the Legacy (Hotel-) version is **not** allowed.
- **All co-op runs** must have POVs included in the speedrun description, or the video link area. 

# **Recording Rules**

- Video must be raw/unedited (unless editing a timer/subtitles in).
- **Audio is required to be audible across every run, as well as having some sort of viewable quality (preferably above 25fps)**
- For solo runs, doorknobs and revives must be visible in the top right corner with nothing blocking it. **Top 5 co-op runs require doorknobs to be visible across all povs**.
- **XBOX players** are allowed to stop and then start recording immediately after since they can only record to 10 minutes.

*(These are the rules for the Jeff Shop Update version; select the appropriate version before reading.)*

# General Rules

- In no shop runs, you are not allowed to buy from the ***pre-run shop***, you are however allowed to buy from the mid-run shop.
- In shop runs, buying an item from the pre-run shop will be considered as a shop run.
- Absolutely no **modifiers** are allowed.
- Taking items from the ***rift*** is not allowed.
- Max time limit for runs is 30 minutes.
- If you happen to disconnect/leave **in a co-op**, you must include that in the recording otherwise it will invalidate the run (this does **not** include Solos).

# Timing Rules

- Time starts as soon as the **avatar icon(s)** on the **elevator door** disappears (just look at the elevator door at all times).
- Time ends the frame the ending cutscene begins (when one of the the following things happen):

1. Lighting Change (noticeable on high graphics, the boxes change color and the gate has a shadow), usually happens first
2. Elevator Gate appearing - **Noticeable on the ground of the elevator as well** (when the shadows of the gate are visible)
3. Character Teleporting
4. Items/Healthbar disappearing
5. Camera Panning
